reasons: 화풍: 윤곽이 근흑(재질 어두운 톤 아님) (4/4)

surfaces.part: goods (red items on posts) on top of the cart

answer.evidence: The main body is a cart basket. Rows 9-12 form a top band (dark outline at row 9, a lighter back rim at row 10, darker interior at rows 11-12). A bright front-edge line at row 13 (L=208-244) closes the band. Below it, rows 14-21 show the wire-grid front face, about 10 rows including the base shelf at rows 22-23. The red goods in rows 4-8 are decor on top. The tapering left edge (width 29 down to 23) is the cart's own front profile, not a receding side face. Wheels sit at rows 24-26. There is a top surface of about 4 rows with an edge line, plus a clear front face, so it reads as three-quarter.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small grey cart with red goods on top. It has only about 13 colours in total and roughly 3 lightness steps on its grey body. The grid-like basket and wheels read as a uniform dark outline with little grain or per-part shading. 79% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, against 0-1% for the hedge and cheese-stall references, so the outline looks like a neutral sticker line rather than a dark tone of the adjacent material. Its 10 visible tones per tile are on par with the hedge (9) but well below the stall (17) and the roofed well (20). The 0% near-flat coverage shows there are no big flat fills, but the shading is shallower and the surfaces carry less texture than the richer references. It would look thinner and flatter next to the cheese stall and well, so it fails.

surfaces.part: basket mesh front face and tapered end

answer.evidence: The red items on rows 4-8 are goods on the cart, so they count as decor. The main body is the basket, which is 30px wide on rows 9-14. Its top band covers rows 9-13: a dark outline on rows 9-10, darker interior on rows 11-12, and a light front-edge line on row 13 (L=208-244). Below that is a mesh front face on rows 14-21, with a dark base line on row 21 and a light platform band on rows 22-23. Wheels sit on rows 24-26. The top band is only about 5 rows and the mesh face is mostly see-through, but it still has a top band with an edge line and a front face of more than 3 rows.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small grey cart with a row of red items on top, and it has only 13 distinct colours in total. The comparable props, the stall (40) and the well (38), carry about three times as many. Its grey body ramp has about 3 steps: a light rim, a mid grey and a dark grey, with a dotted grid pattern that reads as mesh. Beodeul props use about 5-6 steps per material. 79% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, so the outline is a neutral dark line around the shapes, not a darker tint of each adjacent material. The stall and the hedge, by contrast, measure 1% and 0%. The measured 10 visible tones per tile and 0% near-flat coverage keep it from being plainly flat. But the tones come mostly from the repeated grid and the red items, and the material ramps stay shallow and sticker-like next to the stall and well. It reads as thinner and less crafted than those references.
